attempted_claim: Consider all connected prime reduced alternating link diagrams D in the 2-sphere with twist number t(D)=7, where a twist region is a maximal chain of bigons end to end or an isolated crossing, excluding the standard diagrams of (2,n)-torus links, and let M_D be the complement in S^3 of the link defined by D, equipped with its complete finite-volume hyperbolic metric whenever hyperbolic in the sense of Menasco. Determine V7, the infimum of the hyperbolic volumes vol(M_D) over the hyperbolic members of this family, decide with proof whether this infimum is attained by some member, and list up to mirror image and flype-equivalence all links attaining it together with their certified volumes; a complete answer is a rigorous number V7 plus a proof that no hyperbolic alternating link complement with twist number 7 has smaller volume and either an explicit attaining census or a proof of non-attainment with a minimizing sequence.
decisive_failure: No certified volume or diagram-enumeration software (SnapPy, HIKMOT, Regina, plantri, Sage) was available in the lane, and the only provable analytic interval for twist number 7 has width about 58, so no exact infimum, attainment decision, or census could be established or audited.
